name: guo-jia-heavens-favored-enter-recover-3
notes: Guo Jia, Heaven's Favored (enxi6tshtu, GeneratedMacroCode.php enterAbilities["enxi6tshtu:0"] / customDQHandlers["enxi6tshtu:0:Enter-1"]): "On Enter: You may put three quest counters on CARDNAME. If you don't, recover 3." The champion is patched directly to Guo Jia, Blessed Scion (level 2) with 5 pre-existing damage -- representing already having leveled up twice WITHOUT re-testing those cards' own On Enter clauses -- so a single REAL level-up (2 -> 3, paid with 3 memory filler cards seeded the same turn) reaches Heaven's Favored and fires its genuine On Enter. Verified live: answering NO to "Put 3 quest counters on Guo Jia?" (taking the recover branch) reduces the champion's Damage from 5 to 2. Break/restore verified: commenting out the RecoverChampion() call in the NO branch makes the fixture fail (Damage stays 5) and restoring it passes again. (The separate 'As long as you control a Shenju ally, this card costs 3 less to materialize' cost-reduction clause and the quest-counter YES branch are not covered by this fixture.)

rulesClauses: On Enter: You may put three quest counters on CARDNAME. If you don't, recover 3.
